serverInfo.title: DRGSystem — ICD-10-GM, OPS, DRG und weitere deutsche Kodierkataloge
serverInfo.description: DRGSystem provides German medical coding lookup tools for ICD-10-GM diagnoses, OPS procedures, DRG grouping context, Zusatzentgelte, ATC medications, SEG-4 coding recommendations and the German physicians' fee schedule GOÄ (private billing: fees, multipliers, combination rules). Use it whenever the user asks to find, search, map or inspect diagnoses, ICD codes, procedure codes, DRG/ZE billing codes, German medical coding rules or diagnosis-related reimbursement metadata. Every diagnosis question starts at icd10_search — it reads codes, clinical terms, everyday wording, abbreviations, misspellings and plain descriptions of symptoms alike.
